notes.title: Win any Game of your choice
notes.notes:
The first one who sends us a screenshot of the mystery of the center of the earth wins a game (maximum price of 60 euro btw. 70 us dollar) of its choice!!!
The 2nd and the 3rd will also win games of their choice but lower value (2nd: 30 euro -btw 35 us dollar, 3rd: 10 euro btw 12 us dollar)
Please send the screenshot to: journey@insayn.net with subject Competition.
After you have won, you just need to write a few words about your impressions in a short review on the game page.
Status Updates you will find on our game page at least once a day!!!
We wish good luck to everybody and hope you enjoy!!!!
Now, go for it!!!!!!!
